title: Install the MCP SDK
cmd: pip install -q -r requirements.txt && pip show mcp | sed -n 1,2p

title: Check the server file for risky imports
cmd: grep -nE 'import (os|sys|subprocess|socket|urllib|requests|pathlib|shutil)|open\(' server.py || echo 'no file, network or shell code found in server.py'
show: grep -nE 'import (os|sys|subprocess|socket|urllib|requests|pathlib|shutil)|open\(' server.py || echo 'no file, network or shell code found in server.py'
must_contain: no file, network or shell code found

title: Run the test client
must_contain: no tool we did not intend is exposed
bad input comes back as an error result

title: Run the test client against a server with an extra tool
must_contain: [FAIL] no tool we did not intend is exposed
